analysis.summary: The Context component is a Remotion video scene that visually demonstrates how jev-guard evaluates tool calls within session context. It renders two side-by-side panels: one showing a user-initiated git push (allowed), another showing a malicious instruction injected from a fetched web page (denied). The only 'decision' is a visual highlight animation (hl > 0.5) that red-colors the injected text halfway through its reveal — purely a timed presentation effect, not a runtime judgment.
